_note: First-visit tour (spec 7B.11): six steps. 'area' names a data-area on the page.

steps.title: Build or load
steps.text: Use the Tasks and Platform tabs on the left to build a scenario, or open Examples. Then press Generate Coex View. The badge beside it says if anything needs fixing.

steps.title: Tasks and platform
steps.text: Pick Bluetooth and Wi-Fi activities, then set up the hardware: antennas, isolation, cores and the arbitration policy. Every setting has an info button.

steps.title: The time view
steps.text: Bluetooth lanes are on top and Wi-Fi lanes below. Red numbered bands are conflicts. Drag to move, use + and − to zoom.

steps.title: The frequency view
steps.text: This shows which channels each hop used and where the Wi-Fi channel sits. It follows the time view.

steps.title: The explanation
steps.text: Select a conflict to read what happened, who was involved, why it was a conflict, who won and why, and what would change it.

steps.title: The summary
steps.text: Numbers for the whole run: airtime, overlap, conflicts, delays, throughput impact and anchors. Use Learn for guided lessons and Help for the glossary.
